references.text: A similar command not to take the mother bird together with her young, showing care for animal family bonds and forbidding taking both the mother and offspring at the same time.
The command not to boil a kid in its mother's milk, which also concerns respect for the relationship between mother and offspring.
Reiteration of the prohibition against boiling a kid in its mother's milk, expressing the same principle of care for animals' natural bonds.
Yet another repetition of the prohibition against boiling a kid in its mother's milk, which together with Leviticus 22:28 shows God's concern for animal welfare.
